frozen_geometry_input.source: exact GitHub Actions geometry artifacts referenced by the outlet-freeze registry
frozen_geometry_input.verification: SHA256 of each downloaded GeoJSON must exactly equal geometry_geojson_sha256 in the frozen registry

dem_reconstruction.source_tile_integrity: every tile must already have an identical SHA256 in at least one preregistered outlet candidate; conflicting or unknown tiles fail closed
dem_reconstruction.bbox: reuse the exact WGS84 DEM bbox of the frozen geometry diagnostic selected for each target
dem_reconstruction.merge: rasterio.merge over source COG tiles with exact frozen geometry bbox
dem_reconstruction.integrity_gate: reconstructed GeoTIFF SHA256 must exactly equal dem_utm_sha256 in the frozen geometry registry before any metric is emitted

cell_inclusion.polygon_metrics: project exact frozen polygon to EPSG:32718
cell_inclusion.raster_metrics: cell center inside polygon; rasterio all_touched=false
cell_inclusion.nodata: exclude non-finite or DEM nodata cells

slope.formula: standard 8-neighbor weighted dz/dx and dz/dy on the reconstructed 30 m projected DEM
slope.validity: center cell is reported only with a complete valid 3x3 neighborhood

hydrology.frozen_outlet_mapping: map frozen EPSG:32718 outlet coordinates to reconstructed DEM containing cell; require center distance <= one cell diagonal
hydrology.main_channel_length: maximum D8 cell-center path length among frozen-polygon center cells that route to the frozen outlet
hydrology.routing_integrity: at least 99.5 percent of frozen-polygon center cells must route to the frozen outlet on the exact reconstructed geometry DEM; otherwise fail closed
hydrology.drainage_density_threshold: contributing area >= 0.01 * exact frozen polygon planar area
hydrology.channel_length: sum each qualifying in-basin cell's downstream D8 link once when the downstream cell is also in the frozen polygon

forbidden: read A6680 numeric morphometry before phase-1 output hash is frozen
move an outlet or alter a basin polygon
change source tiles, DEM reconstruction, raster alignment, slope algorithm, D8 method or channel threshold based on resulting values
discard a target because of unexpected morphometry
